Which of these is NOT one of the animals that live only in water?
fish, shark, seahorse are animals that live only in water; camel belongs to animals that live only on land.
Which of these is NOT one of the animals that live both on land and in water?
turtle, frog, seal are animals that live both on land and in water; elephant belongs to animals that live only on land.
Which of these is NOT one of the animals that live only on land?
rabbit, horse, cow are animals that live only on land; toad belongs to animals that live both on land and in water.
